visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a static title screen featuring a white dog character from the 'Weiteng' series, stylized as Jotaro Kujo with a black hat and coat. He points his finger toward the camera against a plain white background. Large yellow text with red outlines reads '如果微疼角色都變成JOJO' in Traditional Chinese. (2) The screen shifts to a digital drawing software interface where a sketch of the dog character is rapidly completed. We see the cursor moving as it adds thick black outlines and fills in colors for the hat, coat, and hair. The drawing captures the distinct 'JoJo' art style with sharp lines and detailed shading on the face. (3) The footage cuts to a real-life man with black hair, presumably the creator, standing in a brightly lit indoor space next to a gray door. He is wearing a black leather jacket and black cap, mimicking the Jotaro pose perfectly by pointing his finger and pulling his cap down slightly. The lighting is soft and neutral. (4) Another speed-drawing sequence follows, this time transforming a round-faced cartoon character into Kakyoin Noriaki. The artist draws the signature green school uniform, a red cherry, and a distinctive hair curl. The process is shown in a high-speed time-lapse format, focusing on the character's focused, serious facial expression. (5) The real-life creator reappears, now wearing an olive-green embroidered jacket with red text on the sleeve. He poses in a narrow white hallway, making flamboyant gestures inspired by Kakyoin. The lighting here is more dramatic, creating deep shadows on the wall behind him as he moves through different 'JoJo poses.' (6) The final segment transitions into a product catalog layout. High-quality photographs of various merchandise items like rings, hats, blankets, and jackets are displayed in a grid. Each item is accompanied by a text label in Traditional Chinese and a price in NT$. The brand logos for XRAGE and JoJo's Bizarre Adventure are prominent at the bottom.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio starts with a fast-paced, high-arousal funky rock track featuring a thick, overdriven electric bassline and a crisp drum kit rhythm. The beat is strong and steady at approximately 130 BPM. There are no spoken vocals, but the music fills the entire frequency spectrum with bright guitars and punchy percussion. (2) Superimposed over the background music are several high-pitched, short-duration digital sound effects that mimic the sound of a stylus clicking and scratching on a tablet. These SFX are synchronized with the rapid movements of the digital brush on screen, adding a layer of sharp, percussive transients to the mix. (3) A sharp, synthesized 'whoosh' sound effect with a wide spectral bandwidth marks a major transition point. This is followed by a slight swell in the music's volume and the introduction of a melodic electric guitar lead that uses a bright, biting tone. The overall loudness is consistent and professionally mastered for high impact. (4) As the video progresses into the product showcase, the background music continues but the melodic lead subsides, leaving a driving rhythmic section of bass and drums. The acoustic texture remains dense and energetic. Occasional digital 'ding' or 'pop' sound effects are used to highlight specific text or price tag appearances. (5) The track concludes with a final crescendo featuring a drum roll and a sustained electric guitar power chord that fades out slowly. A final, clean digital sound effect—a soft chime—plays as the screen displays the brand logos, signifying the end of the promotional segment and the master audio track.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Creative Process -> Result Reveal -> Product Showcase -> Brand Closing.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a creative promotional piece for a collaboration between clothing brand XRAGE and the 'JoJo's Bizarre Adventure' anime. It uses a 'before-and-after' creative hook, showing the transformation of creator 'Weiteng's' characters into the JoJo style, followed by the creator cosplaying the looks and finally showcasing the actual merchandise available for purchase.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of brand logos, products, prices, and an explicit call to action regarding the official website launch.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video blends digital illustration with live-action cosplay and product cataloging, effectively leveraging the 'JoJo' aesthetic to sell apparel.
